text:
matt: Heads-up: PR #4827 changes HPA target from cpu -> custom metric `request_rate`, updates VPA labels, and renames secret path from `/infra/autoscale` -> `/infra/scale`. This touches terraform, k8s manifests, and a small prom-adapter mapping. Need a quick sanity check before merging.

sara: Quick Q — will the secret rename be backwards compatible during rollout? we can't restart all pods at once. Also, what does the terraform change look like?

matt: Terraform side is just the secret resource name and a reference update, plus a small provider alias for the staging vault. Snippet:```hcl
resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret" "autoscale" {
  name = "infra/scale"
}
```
K8s HPA change:```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
spec:
  metrics:
    - type: Pods
      pods:
        metric:
          name: request_rate
        target:
          type: AverageValue
          averageValue: "50"
  behavior:
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
```

anika: Heads-up — prom-adapter mapping needs an entry for `request_rate` -> prometheus query. currently staging metrics don't expose that name. Add mapping like:```yaml
- seriesQuery: 'sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="app"}[1m])) by (pod)'
  name: request_rate
  metricsQuery: '...'
```
Otherwise the HPA will see no metrics and fallback to 0.

leo: Also check PDBs and eviction behavior. If VPA recommends resizes and we simultaneously change HPA to use request_rate, we could get a churn loop. Can we set VPA to "recommendationOnly: true" for the rollout window?

matt: Good call. Plan: set VPA to recommendationOnly in staging for 24h, canary HPA on one shard of the fleet, keep cpu as fallback metric. If request_rate missing, HPA should fall back to cpu target defined in the same object.

sara: For the secret rename: we should add a short-lived sync job that copies `/infra/autoscale` -> `/infra/scale` in staging + prod for 48h so nothing breaks, then rotate references and remove old secret once no callers reference it. I'll add a terraform data source to read either path for a smooth transition.

deploy-bot: smoke-check(staging): HPA sanity test (scale up/down) FAILED on first run — metric not found in prom-adapter. See logs: `metric "request_rate" not found`.

anika: I can push the prom-adapter mapping in a follow-up PR in staging. Will also add unit test for metric parsing.

leo: Also add annotation to provisioner to prevent immediate scale-down of nodes with recently started pods: `karpenter.sh/eviction-delay: "5m"` — avoids flapping during canary.

matt: Rollout checklist: 
- [ ] add prom-adapter mapping (anika)
- [ ] secret sync job + terraform data fallback (sara)
- [ ] set VPA recommendationOnly in staging (leo)
- [ ] apply HPA change to canary namespace (matt)
- [ ] monitor replica counts, latency, error rate for 2h (ops oncall)
- [ ] then merge to main and roll to prod with 24h wait

sara: +1 on checklist. I will add the sync job as a k8s CronJob:```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: secret-sync-autoscale
spec:
  schedule: "*/15 * * * *"
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          containers:
          - name: sync
            image: alpine/curl
            command: ["/bin/sh","-c","vault read -format=json secret/infra/autoscale > /tmp/a && vault write secret/infra/scale @/tmp/a"]
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
```

ops-bot: Reminder: add alert on HPA metrics missing (`hpa.metrics_missing: count > 0`), and auto-revert toggle in console if we see > 5% error increase.

leo: I can run the staging canary once the prom mapping is in. Ping me when PRs are up and tests pass.

matt: Thanks all — I'll hold merge until prom mapping + sync job are in. Tagging @leo @anika @sara for follow-ups. If staging alerts spike after canary I'll roll back and post here. :thumbsup:
